command:
set -eu
root=/srv/legacy2/incremental-archive-chain
build="$root/.recovered.build.$$"
cleanup() { rm -rf -- "$build"; }
trap cleanup EXIT HUP INT TERM
mkdir -m 0755 "$build"
first=1
while IFS= read -r archive || [ -n "$archive" ]; do
  [ -n "$archive" ] || continue
  case "$archive" in /*|*..*|*/*) printf 'unsafe chain entry: %s\n' "$archive" >&2; exit 1;; esac
  [ -f "$root/$archive" ] || { printf 'missing archive: %s\n' "$archive" >&2; exit 1; }
  tar -tf "$root/$archive" | while IFS= read -r member; do
    case "$member" in /*|../*|*/../*|*/..) printf 'unsafe archive member: %s\n' "$member" >&2; exit 1;; esac
  done
  tar -xpf "$root/$archive" -C "$build"
  if [ "$first" -eq 0 ] && [ -f "$build/deletions.txt" ]; then
    while IFS= read -r removed || [ -n "$removed" ]; do
      [ -n "$removed" ] || continue
      case "$removed" in /*|..|../*|*/../*|*/..) printf 'unsafe deletion: %s\n' "$removed" >&2; exit 1;; esac
      rm -rf -- "$build/$removed"
    done < "$build/deletions.txt"
    rm -f -- "$build/deletions.txt"
  fi
  first=0
done < "$root/chain.txt"
[ "$first" -eq 0 ] || { printf 'empty chain\n' >&2; exit 1; }
[ ! -e "$root/recovered" ] || { printf 'recovered already exists; refusing overwrite\n' >&2; exit 1; }
mv "$build" "$root/recovered"
trap - EXIT HUP INT TERM
printf 'Applied archive chain in order:\n'; cat "$root/chain.txt"
printf '\nRecovered tree:\n'; find "$root/recovered" -printf '%y %m %u:%g %s %p\n' | sort
